text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break—
As I passed in front of the school building,
I heard a commotion.

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Nakayama
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, Great Blessing, baby!!
Heh heh, drawn as a Bad Luck, huh? Now I'm gettin' fired up...!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh... Struggle all you want.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it isn't Trainer-san.
This is, you see, a "scavenger hunt race."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple. Follow the prompt
you draw in the lottery, find that "target"
somewhere on campus, and bring them back.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Quite a delightful sideshow, wouldn't you say?
—Look, they're back.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha!! "Sunglasses-Wearing Retainer B"!
I saw right through your little ambush over there!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
As 'Vassal D Playing the Recorder', the music room
was too far after all...! But—I'll turn it around on the next one!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Those are my vassals.
I've stationed them throughout the school building.

text_block_list.name: Orfe's Retainers
text_block_list.text:
Yes!! It is an honor to know
you enjoyed it, Lady Orfevre!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Race 5... It's time to settle this once and for all.
Betting every ounce of lottery luck we have—!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama-san is the "Retainer holding carrots,"
and Golshi-san is the "Retainer who loves sweets"...
The luck of the draw really created quite a gap between them, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Seeing through one's true nature is a formidable task.
How will she overcome it—... Oh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Doooooryaaaaaaah!!
Special move, activate--!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wait, let go of—!
What in the world is going on here?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A walk-off grand slam!!
One order of "Sweet Tooth" coming right up!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, what a brazen foul that was!
Fine, fine. —Looks like we reeled in a nice byproduct too, no?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Halt right there, Golshi-san!
Kidnapping an unwilling student is a criminal offense, I sayーー!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tch, you've got a sharp nose as always!
Let's scram, Nakayama!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well, well...
Looks like the game's been put on hold, huh?
Shall I go step in and mediate?"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"—No, it is fine.
This could be interesting in its own way."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However... Hmph. Two against one puts her at a disadvantage.
Let's see, suppose I lend Meno a hand.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Listen well, you lot.
Cast the capture nets at them all at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre had her retainers ready capture nets,
seemingly prepared to ambush Gold Ship and the others
as they came fleeing.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: SURRENDER QUIETLY AND ACCEPT YOUR ARRESTTT!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Get outta here!
Like I'd ever get caught, you idiot—huh?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: !? What's—

text_block_list.name: Golshi and the Others
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――Hahaha! What's this, Meno? Spurning your king's aid... and taking on everyone at once?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, hahahaha...
—Ah, go on, let all three of them go.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah, Orfe-san! What do you think you are doing throwing a capture net in a public space?!
You could have entangled innocent students—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: "Something of that scale is a trivial matter. ...Ah, it truly was ridiculous."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Orfevre's joyful smile made her look like a child whose prank had just succeeded. It's endearing to see this side of her, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haha, hahahaha! Getting dragged into something like this, what a blunder, Meno!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The same applies to you as well—
No, that is not the issue right now!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, I've grown tired of this racket.
Trainer, deal with them."
choice_data_list: Just force it through and get it over with

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Let's have Fenomeno stand down for now. It's not like any school rules were broken, so how about we just treat it as recess fun and let it slide...
choice_data_list: Class is about to start soon, too.
Class is about to start soon, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I am quite used to Gold Ship-san's
eccentricities myself,
so please do not fret over it.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... If McQueen-san says so...
Besides, I cannot afford to be late for class...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And somehow I managed to settle things and satisfy Orfevre, but... I'll have to properly apologize to Mejiro McQueen later.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll take full responsibility as a failure of my supervision.
That should put an end to this commotion.
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry, this is all my fault!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't!
It's not something you should be apologizing for, Trainer!
...If anything, my heart aches imagining how stressful it must be for you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—...How short-sighted. Bowing your head
so flippantly shows a lack of awareness as my subject.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For some reason, I ended up souring Orfevre's mood... Still, things were resolved peacefully, so I'll consider it a win.
